items.title: A 65-Year-Old With $1,250,000 in Kimberly-Clark, Prudential and Clorox Collects $4,980 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA 65-year-old with $1,250,000 split evenly across Kimberly-Clark, Prudential Financial and Clorox would collect about $59,800 a year in dividends, or about $4,980 a month. Prudential’s check is the safest of the three, since its dividend uses well under half of its earnings.
